:::{#thm-total-prob-1}
#### An event and its complement sum to 1

For any event $A$ and its [complement](#def-complement) $\neg A$:

$$\Pr(A) + \Pr(\neg A) = 1$$

:::

::: proof

The [events](#def-event) $A$ and $\neg A$ are a [partition](#def-partition) of $\samplespace$ (@prp-complement-partition),
so they are disjoint, and their [union](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-union) is $\samplespace$.

$$
\ba
\Pr(A) + \Pr(\neg A)
&= \Pr(A \cup \neg A)
&& \text{(additivity of probability for disjoint events)} \\
&= \Pr(\samplespace)
&& \text{(} A \cup \neg A = \samplespace \text{)} \\
&= 1
&& \text{(probability of the sample space is 1)}
\ea
$$

:::
